round2: Robin scored 17 and shared the lead with Marc. Marc, Derrick and Glenda each picked all four series in six games. Jamie jumped from 13th to 6th as the only one to nail Montreal in seven. Sophie and Theodore were the low scorers at 5.
round3: Kiersten nailed Carolina in five for a round-high 15 and jumped from 15th to 8th. Derrick scored 12 and retook the lead. Jake scored zero.
round4: Jaclyn, Jamie, Nickall, Ryan and Stephanie nailed Carolina in six for 15 each. Eight players took Vegas, and Glenda, Jake, Marc, Sophie and Theodore got zero. Nickall has now had the highest conference finals score three years in a row. Kiersten has picked the wrong Cup winner six years running.
overall: Derrick won his fifth title with 49 points, 20 years after his previous one in 2006, beating Jamie and Nickall (both 47) by two points. He did it while picking the wrong Cup winner for the fourth year in a row. Jamie climbed from 13th after Round 1 to 2nd, and Nickall went from 15th last year to 3rd. Glenda fell from 1st to 10th, Jake from 2nd to 13th, and Benedict from 3rd to last for the first time, with 25.
